🔄 Content update (Updated: August 7, 2026 / Previous: July 16, 2026)

Showa 100 Special Exhibition: "Hanno and the Showa Era—The City's Birth and Evolving Lives"

A special exhibition introducing the city's history from the Showa to Reiwa eras and how people's lives have changed, using materials from the museum collection.

【Exhibition Dates】
July 19 – August 30, 2026 (Reiwa 8)
9:30 AM – 4:30 PM
Closed Mondays (except July 20), July 21 (Tue), July 24 (Fri), August 12 (Wed), August 28 (Fri)

• August 23 (Sun) 10:00–10:30 AM / 3:00–3:30 PM

Evening Museum (extended hours until 7 PM, with ~30-minute explanation 6:00–6:30 PM)
• August 11 (Tue, national holiday)
• August 29 (Sat)

Workshop—Interactive quiz (no advance registration needed, drop-in welcome)
